#### A rule that memorizes

Now make the rule far more flexible:
label each image with the digit of the training image nearest to it in (center ink, left ink).
This is [one-nearest-neighbor](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/non-parametric-models.html#k-nearest-neighbors) classification.
Using the split from @sol-held-out-averages,
what share of the [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set) and of the [test set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-test-set) does it get right?

:::
